name: Survey tile in Capricornus
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 1.1 degrees north of the ecliptic in Capricornus, imaged by SPHEREx 16 times in 6 visits over 54 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 32 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 2.2 days starting 2025-10-13, at wavelengths from 0.82 to 4.56 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
